note: Franky's notebook. Written by the duck itself (the model's weights never change). tries = attempts the note was shown in, wins = how many of those succeeded.

knowledge.text: The vision model may fail to find the green box after the initial detection, returning "no box.
The task is incomplete if the green box cannot be visually located after picking up the banana.
Successful pickup occurs when the banana's middle is within 0.07m of the beak tip.
Successful pickup occurs when the banana's long side is within 30 degrees of being across the beak.

skills.text: If the green box is not found, keep searching for it until it is located or the command is explicitly finished.
To pick up the banana, align it so its middle is within 7cm and its long side is within 30 degrees of being across the beak.
